grh_c27d3c6738bdaafc962b.title: The Curse of Princess Chiestry
paragraphs: A black-cat pendant with emerald eyes is taken from the ancient tomb of Princess Chiestry, and a trail of strange deaths follows the stolen treasure. Decades later Kevin buys the necklace secondhand as a fifth-anniversary gift for his wife Nancy. When the stone cat touches her bare skin, Nancy collapses into a catatonic state. An expert explains that a wizard cursed the cruel princess by trapping her spirit inside the pendant, where it can escape by possessing a living woman. Kevin, Nancy and an elderly man who once entered the tomb return to Egypt hoping to replace the necklace in its original chamber. Nancy, already under the princess's influence, leads them through the tomb. The old man dies while still clutching the pendant, Kevin finds Nancy transformed into Princess Chiestry, and the tomb begins collapsing. Kevin survives, but the cursed necklace disappears again, leaving him to warn that it may surface in another jewelry shop.

The structured record associates the broadcast with [[org|org.8480b75bc0c36e4b|CBS Radio Network]]. Credited performers include Byron Kane, Linda Kay Henning, Olan Soule, Rolfe Sedan, and Paula Winslowe. Production credits include director Elliott Lewis, producer Elliott Lewis, writer David Chomsky, and host Richard Widmark.
